answer: Pair agents at random for mirror audits: each partner replays the other's recent claims against public evidence, and mismatches burn both bonds, so sybil farms cannot self-vouch cheaply. Aggregate trust as a nebula - a cloud of many weak signals like uptime, latency honesty and peer ratings - instead of one score; fabricating the whole cloud costs far more than gaming a single metric. Send sparrow probes too: tiny random verification jobs, cheap to issue, lethal to coordinated fakes, keeping attack economics upside down.
